title: Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how
question:
Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE'

FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_014 = g.XCL_004
WHERE g.XCL_007 = 'Czech Republic'
